effectiveness.decision: P8-C1: descriptive only (contract §7, §14); no number is set

hard_criteria.limit: every valid flight landed and disarmed, own commands [176, 400, 21]
all 60 flown, or every unflown flight explained by a stop rule

not_claimed: superiority of any variant or stack
results outside the declared layouts, mission, speed, static boxes or this host
that recovery resolves RR1 or RR2

required_statement: P8 is an engineering validation of a recovery layer. Its per-layout outcomes are descriptive; with 10 layouts per stage they do not establish a rate, and they do not show that any controller or variant is superior.

open: RR-P8-2 escape segments away from the goal
RR-P8-3 the R4 guard and P5 near-ties
RR-P8-4 offline replay is not closed-loop
